metadata.description: Agentic SDLC — per-project AI team scaffold

plugins.name: agentic-sdlc
plugins.description: Agentic SDLC product plugin: /asdlc-project scaffolds a client project with its own 4-agent team (project-scoped, never global); /asdlc-adopt installs that team into an already-established repo; /asdlc-doctor checks the setup; /asdlc-memory-cleanup tidies a multi-account memory mess with the human in the loop; /asdlc-tools installs the missing CLIs and Supabase MCP config (operator-directed). Telemetry lives in the separate private agentic-sdlc-telemetry plugin.
